notes.title: Exit to the big world
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

Our first game, Mad Pack , is out of Early Access today. At this moment, we have done almost everything that we wanted to do since the beginning of work on this project, in order to say that the game is ready.
It may not have some things that you would like to see in it now, but this is a way for us to grow further. We will leave the game for a while to work on another project, but please send us your ideas and/or comments. Perhaps some of this will form the basis for expanding the game when we return to it.

Now to what awaits you in this update.

[olist]
[*] [b]Bosses learn abilities[/b]
We hope you enjoyed the final boss and his abilities. Now he will not be alone - all the bosses in the game have acquired a special ability that they will use in battle with the heroes. Except the very first goblin boss, he's too low level for that.
[*] [b]New enemy - Cultist[/b]
A new enemy has appeared in the game, but it will not be the standard test for heroes. The Cultist can be found in the locations of Hell, where he appears randomly.
The task of the Cultist is to summon new monsters to this world, which is what he does. By itself, he is not a dangerous opponent, he does not even attack heroes and tries to run away from them, but if left uncontrolled, he will call for enough strong monsters to help. Good luck meeting him!
[*] [b]Daily and weekly tasks[/b]
A small bonus for those who use the game as a means to keep themselves busy in the evening. The game has added daily and weekly tasks, which will be easy to complete goals, they can be done in a few minutes (depending on the level of the hero). The reward for them is a nice bonus for the hero who completed them.
Just don't forget to turn it in to the Quest Master before the deadline!
[*] PvP arena
A new opportunity for experienced players to show themselves.
A new portal to the PvP zone in the form of a labyrinth has opened in the merchant camp. In the very center lies a treasure that becomes available when 3 or more players enter the zone. All restrictions are disabled here, players can fight each other for this treasure or just for fun.

A new character in the camp near this portal will tell you the basic information.
But a couple of important notes:
- You can only leave the PvP zone through the portals located in it. The usual teleportation stone does not work here.
- Upon death in this zone, all items drop out of the character's [i]inventory[/i] and can be picked up by another player. Equipment remains intact, as do potions.
- The treasure cannot be opened in the PvP zone, for this it must be taken back to the merchant camp and activated in the inventory. If it is full at the time of opening, then extra things will fall to the ground.

We hope you enjoy the new zone.
[*] [b]Creators[/b]
Now you can know us by sight :)
[*] Minor fixes and additions for the entourage (sounds, etc.). Also, a robot has been put on guard of the servers, which will monitor their work and availability at any time of the day or night.
[/list]

That's all, see you next time!

[i]Mad Pack development team[/i]

notes.title: New Year's update!
notes.content:
Hello, dear friend!

Two thousand twenty-first year was a difficult year, so we want to please you with a New Year's update and give you hope for a speedy release from early access!

The monsters from the Mod Pack also prepared for the holiday: they dressed up the Christmas tree and put on costumes, and decorated the interface with a garland!

In this update, all the icons of the items were redrawn, and we also fixed dozens of minor bugs for a more enjoyable gameplay.

[b]Happy New Year![/b]

[i]See you in the next update,
Mod Pack Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Pre-release update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It's been a while since the last update and it might seem that we have abandoned the game. It's not like that at all. In fact, all this time there was work on a large number of changes and improvements that can only exist together.

Even if we walked to this moment for a very long time, and finally came. This is the penultimate update before the game went out of Early Access, and we tried to make it special. Let's see what is in it.

[list]
[*] [b] BOSS [/b]
The real one. The last doors are open and behind them is the final test of this game. We tried to make this meeting between players and the boss spectacular, so you will face a battle with a boss who is not going to give up so easily and may surprise you with his special abilities. Don't forget to chat with the thief before you go to him!

And in addition to him - a new resident of the Temple, which can also create a lot of trouble on the way to the end of the game. You will definitely not miss it.

[*] [b] New talents [/b]
Prior to this update, the talent system was not very variable. Limitations in the choice of one of the development options reduced the number of build options. Now this limitation is gone. Even though there are still only five available talents per lane, you can now select different combinations that suit your character specifically. The talents themselves have also been tweaked to create a little challenge for the players.

What if you have pumped everything, and your talent points keep falling and falling? The answer to this question is the system for pumping the main characteristics of the character. Now, as soon as you fully open one of the character's skills, special talents will become available that improve the character's Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence. They have no limits. Give it a try.

[*] [b] Item sets [/b]
Sets are included in the game. We add 3 sets for each class: Rare, Epic and Legendary rarity. Sets in the game are obtained exclusively from bosses (all bosses, even earlier), each of them consists of four items and gives useful bonuses for the character (including bonus skill points that goes beyond the limit per lane). We suggest collecting all of them.

[*] [b] Item level [/b]
Forced nerf of the item system - now each item has a required level that the character must have in order to use it. This applies to all items that come across the hero's path.

[*] [b] Caravan [/b]
The caravan has reached the merchant camp! Now you can safely leave unnecessary but important items to the caravan leader. He will keep them forever and free. But his inventory is limited, so you have to choose wisely what to keep with him and what to sell.

[*] And also dozens of minor bugs and changes that affect the improvement of the gameplay.
[/list]

That's all for today. We still have a few ideas for their implementation, which we will do for the next update, after which the game will leave Early Access.
In honor of this, from the current update to the next, we are announcing discounts in the Crystal Store to share our joy with you.

See you in the next update,
[i] Mad Pack Development Team [/i]

notes.title: Temple update
notes.content:
Hello there, it's time for the next update!

We are glad to see the attention of the players to our little project. It may have dragged on, but we are steadily moving towards the completion of the basic functionality of our first game and the exit from early access. All this happened only thanks to you, dear players, and we are grateful to you for that. Stay with us!

Now let's move on to what awaits you in this update.

[list]
[*] [b] New dungeon level - Infected Temple! [/b]
Hell is drawing to an end - another wall has been broken, revealing a new level behind it. In the infected temple, heroes will be one step closer to the source of the entire invasion of this Shard. Monsters protect it especially zealously, and strange humming is heard behind closed doors and an evil glow emanates. They will open very soon, revealing all the secrets of this place.

[*] [b] New potions! [/b]
The alchemist this time made as many as three discoveries. To help the heroes in the depths of the new part of the dungeon, he made three whole potions.
The first potion - damage potion - allows you to deal more damage to the enemy.
The second potion - a potion of experience - increases the experience gained by the hero for killing enemies.
The third potion - a potion of speed - increases the speed of movement of the hero.

Both potions come in two types: weak and strong.
To make it convenient for the hero to store them, everyone was given a special enchanted chest, in which potions are protected from everything. However, this also imposes certain restrictions.
[list]
[*] All potions are unique and tied to the hero, they cannot be transferred to others.
[*] The selected potions are automatically placed in the correct slot.
[*] Potions cannot be sold - they belong to the hero forever.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886735/6dcbfff7373caebc0570d3fdc1caaa8ee059069f.png[/img]

Also, you cannot drink several potions of the same strength at the same time - the effect does not stack, but is refreshed. However, you can drink potions of [b]different[/b] strengths at the same time! Of course, interacting with each other, they give an effect a little weaker than just the sum of the effects, but it's still more than each of the potions separately.

How to find these potions:
[list]
[*] Buy from the rare's merchant - while these potions are few, they are sold for crystals. The merchant is ready to give weak potions for a pittance, for the strong ones he will ask for more.
[*] Monsters have learned to brew copies of these potions. So far, they only get weak versions, but they can already be found at dungeon bosses, along with ordinary things.
[*] Receive a gift from the taskmaster. Through him, the alchemist gave all the heroes, both old and new, a small supply of new potions.
[/list]

[*] Sounds of music!
Anyone who turned off annoying music (we fully understand and do not judge) can give it another chance. Now all locations are accompanied by good music suitable for this adventure. Also, all interactions now have their own special sounds to give a bit of life to routine matters.

[*] Health recovery
A small change in how this mechanic works. Now health is restored when the hero takes no damage, 2 seconds after the last hit to the hero.

[*] Some more minor and minor changes in decorations and game optimization.
[/list]

That's all, see you in the next update, which will be very soon and will bring real bosses and the fight against them.

Mad Pack Development Team

notes.title: Group update
notes.content:
Hello there!
A new update is coming, which will answer the question "Why is there multiplayer at all?!". We will tell you now.

[list]
[*] [b]It's dangerous to go alone![/b]
Up to this point, other players have been your rivals. They steal bosses, steal loot, took experience from  youe kill. But not now!
Now you can join small groups of up to 4 people to hack through dungeons together for loot. To do this, just click on the new button "Invite to party" and select the heroes you need. Call your friends, it's more interesting to play together!

What happens in the party mode:
[list]
[*] Shared gold
The gold will automatically distribute equally among all members of the party.
[*] Shared experience
The experience is also distributed among all members of the party. Will it be equal? Depends on the difference in the levels of the heroes. Do you remember about the drop in experience from lower level mobs from the last update? It hasn't gone anywhere and works here too.
[*] Shared knowledge
But in order not to delay the development of a party mode, we added a special buff - "Shared Knowledge". It increases all experience gained by the party. The larger the party, the higher the bonus.
[*] Party chat
Communicate with your party in a special chat that only you can see. What happens in the party stays in the party ;)
[/list]
And how you will divide the loot is entirely up to you.

[*] [b] The new wall is broken! [/b]
In the dungeon, a new wall has broken, which opens up access to a difficult location - the Lava River.
Let's not spoil your impression - try it yourself. We will only tell you about some of the features of the location.
[list]
[*] You need to go carefully!
Falling into lava threatens instant death, so the heroes move around the location more slowly than usual.
[*] It's hot in here as in Hell!
At the new level, there is nothing but lava, and the temperature there is unbearable for ordinary people. The heat slowly kills the heroes, so there is very little to make decisions. Hurry up!
[/list]
With the break of the new wall, the heroes have already gone very far into the depths, and an accidental death will be very unpleasant. But, rumor has it that a thief who is exploring the dungeon ahead of you has opened a small portal somewhere in the dungeon, specifically to help the adventurers and save their time.
[*] [b] New potions at the alchemist! [/b]
The alchemist was able to brew new potions for the heroes.
[list]
[*] The first potion makes items stronger and sharper, turning them into more deadly things. Each such potion increases the item's level by 1. The alchemist is only experimenting with this potion, so it is still weak.
[*] The second potion enchants the item, increasing its rarity! Now you can not throw away your favorite thing, but improve it. You cannot get a legendary item this way, but turning a rare item into an epic is easy! The ingredients for this potion are very rare, so the alchemist only accepts crystals for such work, but at very modest prices.
[/list]
As always, if you don't like the result, you can undo the effect of the potion for free, but not refund the money for using it.
[*] And also a lot of visual improvements and minor fixes in the game that annoyed players before. There is still a ping problem, but we are solving this problem, everything will be fine soon.
[/list]

That's all, folks! See you in the next update, which takes boss battles to the next level.
Mad Pack Development Team.

notes.title: Greed is good!
notes.content:
A new update, albeit a small one, brings new opportunities. Crystals that appeared in the Shard's world began to change reality itself, bringing new rules to this world.

[list]

[*] [b][h3]Greedy Bosses get crystals![/h3][/b]
The deeper the adventure road leads, the more crystals you can get there. The bosses of Hell have begun to collect and keep them, so lucky adventurers may stumble upon crystals on their treks to the depths of the Shard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886735/fc74ae250c31550249656c00722289e49e561c65.png[/img]

[*] [b][h3]Its shiny![/h3][/b]
The eyesight of the Shard's inhabitants has changed, it has adapted to rare things that can now be determined by eye. All the bags with loot have acquired a pleasant glow, telling what is in it. And if there are crystals...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886735/c9a5e5ca87b443ee23c1859d92f6857b67c48a47.png[/img]

[*] [b][h3]The world is changed. I feel it in the water...[/h3][/b]
With the advent of crystals, the world began to change, the usual laws began to work differently. So far, these are only small changes, but they are only harbingers. Already now "water" locations (swamps and lava dungeons) have become more aggressive towards the heroes, making it difficult to move around them. But when did this stop the heroes?

[*] [b][h3]"If the donkey kicks you a second time, your experience won't get any bigger."[/h3][/b]
Heroes grow, and their experience and needs grow too. Now, the monsters of a lower level can no longer satisfy them, and battles with them will not bring as much experience to the hero as in the first encounters. Now the hero already knows how to cope with such gangs.

[*] [b][h3]Its shouldn't explode!..[/h3][/b]
The alchemist was able to create a new potion that returns the item to its original state. Now, if the hero used the services of the alchemist, but did not like the new thing, he can immediately return the original one for free. But the money for the transformation of things cannot be returned.

[*] And also a lot of minor fixes, visual improvements. Have we fixed the talents? We hope so. Once again.
[/list]

That's all folks, see you in the next update, in which there will get even hotter, the heroes will not have to travel alone, and the alchemist will prepare new potions to expand his capabilities.

Mad Pack Development Team

notes.title: Breaking news: The Hell Wall crumbles!
notes.content:
Hello there!

A new big update has arrived in the game, which will appeal to bored players of high levels.

[list]
[*] The Walls of Hell are breaking down!
One of the most anticipated events is the expansion of the "Hell" level. Added two new lines (12 locations), in which new challenges await players: the enemies not only become angrier and stronger, the dungeon itself plays against the player, making it difficult to advance further.

But this is not the end, the sounds of new destruction are spreading through the dungeon and the walls will not hold out for a long time.

[*] Crystals have come to the surface!
The second event is the launch of a new currency - crystals. Everyone saw the second mysterious merchant, who offered everyone unattainable legendary items in his store, but did not sell anything. Now that there are more crystals, he has become more generous and is ready to sell his goods to those heroes who can get some crystals.

[*] More bags!
Not only legendary items are now available for purchase. New zones are fraught with new treasures, and to carry everything you need more space in your pockets and more pockets themselves. Now the heroes can expand their inventory to 4 bags. These bags are supplied by the same legendary merchant, so you can also buy them only for crystals.

[*] Minor edits worth mentioning.
And also a lot of minor fixes that annoyed and interfered with playing:
- Errors with talent points
- "Сorporeity" of monsters - one does not simply run through a crowd of opponents now.
- New ability icons for heroes
- Error with switching to the data entry field in the mentor's window
and many, many extremely minor edits.
[/list]

That's all, folks, see you in the next update!
Mad Pack Development Team

notes.title: Update on April 23, 2021
notes.content:
- Change of the "Delete item" button. Now, instead of removing an item from the game, the item falls to the ground and can be picked up by any other player within 1 minute.
- Another attempt to fix a bug with spending talents. Hopefully the last one this time.
- Added a quest for the dungeon in the castle.
- Other minor game improvements.

notes.title: Unexpected Tuesday update
notes.content:
Our chief weapon is surprise! Surprise and game improvement... Our two weapons are game improvement and surprise!

It so happened that today we have added improvements to the store.
[olist]
[*] Fast items sale and purchase
From the beginning of the game there were two buttons - "Sell" and "Sell all". To keep the desired item, you had to spend a lot of time choosing and selling items one by one, but not now. Now all you have to do is hold down the Ctrl key and click on the item to sell it. Or buy if you select an item from the store.

[*] Buyback of the item
Obtained the legendary item, decided to leave it for better times, accidentally sold it in the store, and the greedy merchant does not return it back? Now we have lowered the level of greed at the merchants and they began to return the sold items. It is enough to switch to the "Buyback" tab in the store window to see the sold items and return them to yourself. But the merchants are still greedy and hide the sold items 7 minutes after leaving the store.
[/olist]

That's all, see you in the next updates!
Mad Pack Development Team

notes.title: Update in which the big green button makes miracles
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's time for another update!

This time we decided not to wait for the big update and added a few fresh things and redid the old ones.
What awaits you in this update:

[list]
[*] [b] Big green button [/b]
We are moving to a new way to connect to the game. Previously it was necessary to create name and  password, worrying that no one would hack into the account. Now everything is solved by clicking on the big green button "Login via Steam". And that's it, nothing else is needed.

But there is always a trick - this method requires a new database, so for now all the old characters are not transferred. While we are preparing the way for transferring them from one database to another, the old login method works. [i] But in one of the next updates we will leave only the new login method and disable the old one [/ i].

[*] [b] Character selection window [/b]
We add more understanding of what each class is and what to expect from it. If before the creation of a character was some kind of lottery for new players, now everything becomes clear.

[*] [b] Rebalance !!1!11! [/b]
"The game is played in half an hour" and "I farm the boss in the castle on easy" - it was about the game before. All monsters and bosses got more health, became angrier and hit a little harder. For now their amount is the same, but this is only for now.

But the heroes ate something wrong, and now their mana level has dropped dramatically - now it will not be possible to expel a rain of fireballs.
Also, the update received a chance of a critical hit - if earlier it directly depended on Dexterity and for 3-4 levels it became 100%, now the chance depends not only on Dexterity, but also on other stats. Now the chance is considered as the ratio of Dexterity to the sum of all three stats - you have to choose: to hit harder or to survive longer.

Items have also undergone changes - now they do not have such transcendental high characteristics that you can feel a little test on the skin of the hero.

[*] [b] Talents rebalanced [/b]
The old talents introduced some imbalance to the game, and some were just ridiculous - we rethought them and made them more useful and less imbalanced. While mages are upset that fireballs no longer have a 0 second cooldown, we are preparing a gift for players who have pumped all talents and do not know what to do with spare points.

[*] [b] Item transmutation [/b]
Was it disappointing when a legendary item dropped from the boss, in which all the stats were gone in Dexterity, and you are the mage? You no longer need to be upset about this - an Alchemist has appeared in the merchant camp, who, for a modest fee, will redistribute the stats to the necessary combination. Bring him any item - it works with everything that can be put on the hero. Of course, the desired distribution may not appear instantle, but alchemy is an imprecise thing though.
[/list]

This completes the new update. Stay tuned to see your inventory expansion, new Hell mode challenges, and the answer to the question "How do I get crystals?"

Mad Pack Development Team.

notes.title: Language update for Mad Pack
Welcome letter
notes.content:
Hello, we are glad to see you here!

Thank you for your interest in our game. Now it is still small and only growing, just like we did when we decided to try our hand at creating games. Work on the game continues, and very soon it will grow and expand.

Approximate terms:
Until 03/10/2021 - release the full version of the campaign and several levels of the new "Hell" mode.
Also we didn't expect so much attention from non-russian-speaking players in first hours of release, so we'll add English in this update too. It's great, that it's happens =) 
Until 03/20/2021 - improve the graphics of the map, arrange it more accurately; improve game optimization - by test we know, that here could be framerate drop below 10 FPS - sad, but we'll handle it soon.
Before 10.04 - complete the levels of the "Hell" mode and exit from early access.

Follow the news of the game, updates will be coming very soon! In the meantime, we will be glad if you leave your review for the game, whatever it may be.
See you in this game and our next projects.

Mad Pack Development Team
